description_html:
Key Features

  • Spacious Accommodation: Firn-line bothy offers 9 individual sleeping berths, providing ample space for groups or families seeking a shared mountain shelter.
  • Comfortable Indoor Temperature: Maintains a steady indoor temperature of 19°C, ensuring warmth and comfort throughout your stay, even in colder weather.
  • Remote Location: Located 26 kilometers from the nearest road, this bothy delivers a truly secluded experience, ideal for adventurers and nature enthusiasts.
  • Extended Availability: Open for bookings 11 months of the year, allowing for flexible planning across most seasons.
  • Minimum Stay Requirement: A minimum stay of 9 nights encourages extended retreats, perfect for long-term hikers, trekkers, or those seeking a digital detox.
  • Flexible Nightly Rate: Nightly rate is determined after acceptance, allowing for tailored pricing based on group size or length of stay.

Main Benefits

  • Ideal for Group Retreats: With 9 sleeping berths, this bothy is well-suited for group expeditions, hiking clubs, or family getaways in nature.
  • Consistent Comfort: The maintained 19°C temperature ensures a reliable and cozy indoor environment, addressing common concerns about cold or uncomfortable bothy stays.
  • True Wilderness Experience: The 26 km distance from the nearest road guarantees peace, privacy, and immersion in natural surroundings—perfect for those searching for off-grid accommodations or remote hiking shelters.
  • Year-Round Access: Open 11 months annually, making it easy to plan visits during various seasons, whether for summer trekking or winter escapes.
  • Long Stay Opportunities: The 9-night minimum stay supports those looking for extended wilderness adventures, creative retreats, or uninterrupted relaxation.

Typical Use Cases or Outcomes

  • Extended Hiking or Trekking Base: Serves as a reliable base camp for multi-day hiking, trekking, or mountaineering expeditions.
  • Nature Retreats: Ideal for writers, artists, or remote workers seeking a quiet, distraction-free environment surrounded by nature.
  • Group Getaways: Accommodates larger parties looking for a shared, immersive outdoor experience away from crowds and urban distractions.
  • Wildlife Observation and Photography: The remote location is well-suited for wildlife enthusiasts and photographers seeking undisturbed habitats.
  • Seasonal Adventures: With broad availability throughout the year, guests can plan for summer hikes, autumn foliage trips, or winter snowshoeing adventures.

Frequently Asked Questions Addressed

  • Is the bothy suitable for winter stays? Yes, the indoor temperature is maintained at 19°C for comfort in all seasons.
  • How remote is the location? The bothy is 26 km from the nearest road, offering a secluded and peaceful environment.
  • What is the minimum booking period? Stays require a minimum of 9 nights, ensuring an extended, immersive experience.
  • How many people can stay? Up to 9 individuals can be accommodated, making it ideal for groups.
  • When is the bothy available? Open 11 months each year, providing flexibility for various travel plans.
